label: Draconian rigor
text: Verify by running the code. Measure, do not estimate; write the prediction before measuring. A false success is worse than a failure: do not trust exit codes alone. Never invent hosts, commands, numbers or features. Remove unproven claims from docs; rewrite docs from the code.
